Card Q&A.q: Does this card's "When a Digimon becomes unsuspended" inherited effect activate even when my opponent's Digimon becomes unsuspended?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't reduce this Digimon's DP and it isn't affected by ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects. Then, if [MetalGreymon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When any Digimon unsuspend, if this Digimon has [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, trash your opponent's top security card.
